title.es: Aquel en el que sospechan de la llamada oculta
title.en: The One Where They Suspect the Hidden Call

description.es: Marta se reúne con Cloe y, además de tratar asuntos de la empresa, le confiesa su deseo de conservar su amistad. Mientras tanto, en la casa grande, Fina se reúne con Digna y le confiesa que finalmente llamó a Bianca y que esta le reveló haber intentado localizarla antes. Juntas, Fina y Digna atan cabos y sospechan que Marta fue quien ocultó esa llamada.
description.en: Marta meets with Cloe and, besides dealing with company matters, confesses her wish to keep their friendship. Meanwhile, at the big house, Fina meets with Digna and confesses that she finally called Bianca and that Bianca revealed she had tried to reach her before. Together, Fina and Digna put the pieces together and suspect that Marta was the one who hid that call.
